lines.en: I come on without a single pause.
My stride hasn't changed once.
However fast you run, I keep pace.
I cross the corridor with steady feet.
Each step is quicker than the last.
The lights go out along my path.

lines.zh: 我不看你，也知道你在哪。
lines.en: I don't have to look; I know where you are.
My body never turns aside.
I step over what's on the floor.
I stop, and only for an instant.
Then I move on again.
I stand, and I'm still coming.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛只看一个方向。
lines.en: My eyes face only one direction.

lines.zh: 我等的时间不超过一秒。
lines.en: I never wait more than a second.
My body leans forward.
Stopping isn't in my plans.
The light here doesn't stop me.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，朝你的背影伸。
lines.en: I raise a hand toward your retreating back.
My breathing hasn't broken at all.
I'm readying for the next stretch.
I never stand still for long.
I have been getting closer all along.

lines.zh: 这里没有可以拦住我的东西。
lines.en: Nothing here can hold me back.

lines.zh: 我的脚步一直保持这个节奏。
lines.en: My steps hold this same rhythm.
I'm watching you. You're running.
You run well. Not well enough.
I never tire.
You look back, and I'm there.
The gap keeps shrinking.
You'll stop first.
You still have a long way.
I have been here from the start.
No matter; I'll wait for you to rise.
You can hear me. That is enough.
I have watched you since you came in.
You do not dare stop with me watching.
You must be very tired now.
Are you still thinking of another way?
I will not miss a single thing.
Let us run another stretch.
I never stop.
You missed your footing.
I falter once, then keep chasing.
This doesn't affect my speed.
My eyes are still on you.
Even my breathing hasn't changed.
I got a little closer.
I feel no pain at all.
I veered slightly off line.
I corrected it.
Your effort has clear limits.
I am still running all the same.
You're holding things while you run.
That won't slow me down.
Drop it. Run faster.
That thing is of no use to me.
You can keep it, but you can't take it with you.
It's no use to you now.
That will not stop me for one step.
Try again and it ends the same way.

lines.zh: 我只看你，不看它，别转头。
lines.en: I watch only you, not it; do not turn.
You hit me, and I don't slow at all.
I'm almost pushing you along.
You're shoved forward into a stumble.
I'm wider than you.
We brush past each other.
I didn't give way.
And I close in again at once.
Your shoulder hits my chest.
That is also of no consequence.
There's no other chaser.
I have only one direction.
The rest I don't care about.
I never stop to look.
I'm the only one on this road.

lines.zh: 它们站在一边，让我过去。
lines.en: They stand aside and let me pass.
I don't answer them.
I only see ahead.
This road is long.
I don't feel tired.
The floor's clutter means nothing to me.
I walked right over it.
None of this is my purpose.
It's yours.

lines.zh: 我脚下那东西响了一声，我继续走。
lines.en: Something cracks under my foot; I keep walking.
I did not stop at all.
I kicked it against the wall.
Go back for it if you want it.
I only go forward.
There's no looking back.

lines.zh: 我一开始就知道你在哪。
lines.en: I knew where you were from the start.
Now I begin to run.
Distance no longer matters.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，我已经对准了。
lines.en: I have your footsteps fixed.
I worked out your direction long ago.
I don't shout, and I don't need to.
The moment you stop, I'm there.

lines.zh: 我始终朝你的方向，从不绕路。
lines.en: I stay aimed at you and never detour.
I will not lose you.
Once the chase starts, I do not stop.
This time there's nowhere to go.
I will keep running on.
I have never stopped.
Just keep running.
I am right against the back of your head.
My speed never changes.
You turn, and I'm there first.
You go up; I go up.
I hear every step you take.
Your options are getting shorter.
The corridor has no forks.
Your hands are on your knees.
I'm waiting behind you.
This road will run out.
Pick up the pace.
I still have some to spare.
Do not fall down.
I'll help you back up.
I reach and catch hold.
You're dragged backward.
My strength hasn't dipped at all.
You break free; I follow.
That left you unsteady.
I hit your back.
You've dropped things all over.
I have not stopped once.
You're shoved into the wall.
We keep running.
That landed on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你没有回头，我就在后面。
lines.en: You did not look back, and I am behind you.
All the better, then.
I'm already on this road.

lines.zh: 我的身形出现在走廊尽头。
lines.en: My shape appears at the corridor's end.
I didn't need to be released.
The moment I appear, I start running.
The lights go out one by one.
No one summoned me.
I hear footsteps ahead.
Chasing you, I don't slow down.
My eyes only face forward.
This is where it starts.
My breathing is even.
Whoever's ahead has started running.
I like this stretch.
I will not stop for a single step.
Listen; I'm behind you.
This is the chase form.

lines.zh: 火在走廊里烧，我穿过去。
lines.en: Fire burns in the corridor; I walk through it.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上落下，马上又跑。
lines.en: I drop down the stairs and run on.

lines.zh: 水挡了一下，只是挡了一下。
lines.en: Water slows me once. Only once.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推到墙上，我弹回来。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the wall; I rebound.
An arrow sticks in me. I don't stop.

lines.zh: 光想束缚我，很快就散了。
lines.en: Light tries to bind me; it soon breaks.

lines.zh: 我不会饿，也不去吃东西。
lines.en: I do not get hungry, and I do not eat.

lines.zh: 雷打在我前面，我绕过去。
lines.en: Lightning strikes ahead; I step around it.

lines.zh: 这里没有路，我仍然朝前。
lines.en: There's no road here, and I still go forward.
